name: TIP32C
description: Medium-power PNP in TO-220, -100V/-3A, the complement to the TIP31C. The C suffix is the 100V grade. Identical TO-220 B-C-E pinout to the TIP31C; only the polarity differs. Values are magnitudes; rails are negative.

pins.name: C
pins.description: collector (tied to the metal mounting tab)

TO-220.notes: printed face toward you, tab at back, leads down: B-C-E. Same as TIP31C. Tab = collector (live).

typical_application: PNP half of complementary push-pull power/audio output stages with a TIP31C, high-side motor and relay drivers, complementary Darlington and linear power circuits.
gotchas: collector is on the tab (same as TIP31C); isolate from grounded heatsinks; in a complementary pair both tabs are live
all ratings negative (PNP): emitter is the most positive terminal, collector the most negative
low Vebo magnitude (-5V); same reverse base-emitter caution as TIP31C
only the C grade is 100V; pair with a matching TIP31C grade
